title: Briefing for 2026-10-12
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-12: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Americans' debt problems are flashing a warning not seen since the Great Recession. Treasury's Bessent hires Trump's controversial former Fed board pick, Judy Shelton, as advisor. Inflation on many everyday items was entirely due to tariffs, NY Fed says. Inflation fears on the rise as one-year outlook in Fed survey hits highest level since May 2023. ICE came to town and left behind weakened economies. Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva.
global: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk. Citroen revives the 2CV for an electric age. Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky calls it a gift to Putin. Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices. Boots has a new owner: Three ways it could affect you. Burnham promises to curb non-compete rules in job contracts.
philippines: Lino Cayetano is Marcos’ 6th communications chief. [Inside the Newsroom] How Rappler uncovered Sara Duterte’s company contracts with Davao City Hall. Between adolescence and parenthood: Photo stories of Filipino teen parents. Trump calls for replacing Ukraine’s Zelenskyy in tussle over diesel deal with Russia.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
